purpose gap: Tested: the profile is root:root 0600, NetworkManager loads it as an OpenVPN connection named p8test-vpn, it carries remote/CA/VPN user/cipher/password auth/tap from the parameters, only p8testuser is permitted, and its UUID is the version-5 fqdn_uuid of the name (I computed uuid5(DNS,'p8test-vpn') = df2d3b4d-5aa3-564f-92d4-fd9bac9644f9). The reviewer run reproduced ALL_PASS. GAP: the class exists to connect to the VPN (manifest :2), and the one uncovered row, 'connecting through the profile to an OpenVPN server', is something this lab can test. (1) Its reason says an agent-owned password (password-flags=1) needs a desktop session's secret agent. It does not: nmcli 1.46.0 on p8lab-gnome lists 'nmcli connection up <ID> passwd-file <file>', which makes nmcli itself the secret agent with no session, run as root in a mutating node action. The evidence (session_problems accepts only plasma) shows the runner cannot start a GNOME session. It does not show the lab cannot connect. (2) The lab already provides 'an OpenVPN server peer': the runner's peer block (ubuntu2, second-node, active) installs and runs openvpn in mutating peer checks with tap and password auth, and routes 203.0.113.50 via the node's host-only address (openvpn_server.yml, network_vpn.yml). So the lifted_by capability is not missing. Also not in the outcomes table or the probes, although nmcli vpn.data shows them and a connection depends on them: the fixed transport settings of connection_file.erb:9-17 (remote-random=no, password-flags=1, comp-lzo=yes, proto-tcp=no i.e. UDP, mssfix=no) and the ipv4/ipv6 method=auto of :22-29.
